search_files.desc: Find files and directories by NAME using glob patterns. Use this to locate files when you know (part of) the name but not the location. Supports *, **, ?, and {a,b} alternation. Patterns without / match filename only; patterns with / or ** match full relative path. For searching file CONTENTS, use grep_files instead.

params.path: Root directory to search from. Defaults to the server's current working directory.

grep_files.desc: Search file CONTENTS for a pattern. Returns matching lines with file path and line number. For finding files by NAME, use search_files instead. Supports literal strings and Go regex, context lines, pagination, glob filtering, multiline patterns, and three output modes (content / files_with_matches / count).

params.path: File or directory to search. Defaults to the server's current working directory.
params.pattern: Literal text or regular expression. For regex syntax (|, ., *, +, ^, $, [], \w, \d, etc.) set use_regex=true; otherwise the pattern is matched as a literal string.
params.use_regex: Treat pattern as a Go regular expression. Default: false. Required for alternation (|), wildcards (., +, *), anchors (^, $), and character classes.
params.context_lines: Context lines before and after each match. Default: 0. Max: 50.
params.max_results: Max matches per page (content mode). Default: 50.
params.offset: Skip the first N matches (for pagination). Default: 0
params.glob: Only search files matching this glob pattern (e.g. *.go, *.{ts,tsx}). Default: all files
params.output_mode: Output format. Default: "auto" (shows matching lines when results fit within max_results; switches to file-path list when results are capped). Options: "auto" (default — adapts based on result count), "content" (always show matching lines), "files_with_matches" (only file paths), "count" (match counts per file).
params.multiline: Enable multiline patterns that span lines. Default: false
params.max_file_size: Skip files larger than this many bytes. Default: 0 (no limit).
